signal: Warmly raised a $6M Series A+ bringing total Series A to $17M, passed 300 customers, and is doubling its European headcount

email.body1:
Keegan, saw Warmly raised its Series A+ to $17M total, passed 300 customers, and is doubling the European team.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Warmly off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Keegan, quick follow-up for Warmly.

Post-raise and expanding into Europe, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Warmly needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Keegan, last bit of proof for Warmly.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Warmly's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A GTM-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Keegan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The raise-to-EU-expansion stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I will tailor it to Warmly either way.
